verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at https://docs.n8n.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It is a structured index of the docs that links to Markdown versions of pages (e.g. welcome.md), so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or other agent-oriented docs offerings (e.g. a full-text llms-full.txt), and independent or hands-on reports of agents using it.
